projects.title: MemBlock
projects.subtitle: VS Code Extension · March 2026
projects.description:
A VS Code extension that retains knowledge for developers using GitHub Copilot by saving code snippets and notes from existing/ongoing chat sessions to use as memory context.

It provides a local-first memory engine with configurable review scheduling, Markdown-based flashcard support, and seamless editor integration, enabling developers to retain concepts without leaving their coding workflow.
